ethics_assessment.self_assessment_statement: An ethics self-assessment will be completed as an essential part of the application, consistent with the Tier 1 requirement that applicants complete an ethics self-assessment and that projects with ethics issues may undergo ethics review, with ethics requirements potentially becoming contractual obligations (implementation_constraints.json ethics_self_assessment_required, ethics_appraisal_summary). The Tier 3 compliance_profile.json records ethics_review_required: true as a compliance flag derived during call binding; no Tier 2B extracted source path (scope_requirements.json / call_constraints.json) cites a topic-specific ethics-review mandate for this call, so the ethics-review expectation is treated as a Tier 3 derivative compliance flag pending Tier 2B confirmation rather than as a confirmed call-specific mandate. The self-assessment will address (i) the development and use of AI-based predictive systems (WP3, WP5), evaluating whether human-rights or values concerns arise and how they are addressed; (ii) good scientific conduct, research integrity and Open Science culture, which are call-confirmed training requirements traceable to Tier 2B SR-04 and CC-09; and (iii) the exclusive civil focus of the action, confirming that no excluded activities are involved. Integration of the gender dimension in research and innovation content follows the Tier 1 default rule that it is mandatory unless the topic explicitly states non-relevance (implementation_constraints.json gender_dimension_in_content). No Tier 2B exemption source is currently cited in this Phase 6 artifact; Phase 8 drafting must either add the relevant Tier 2B topic-source reference or keep the claim framed as pending call-specific confirmation. On gender equality at the organisational level, the Tier 3 compliance_profile.json records gender_plan_required: true as a compliance flag derived during call binding; this aligns with the Tier 1 rule that public bodies, research organisations and higher education establishments in Member States/Associated Countries must have a gender equality plan at grant signature (implementation_constraints.json gender_equality_plan_eligibility), and beneficiaries must promote equal opportunities and aim for gender balance at managerial level (gender_management_balance_guidance).
